plainText:
Houko Kuwashima (Japanese: 桑島法子 Houko Kuwashima) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Houko was born on Dec 12, 1975 Iwate, Japan. Houko became a voice actor in 1988 and voiced characters of the day during and . She has also voiced Lucca, Liko's mother, in .
